name: yaps
title: Yaps Memory
description: Search your local Yaps memory and save clipboard text as Markdown notes.
author: yaps

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Yaps CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional executable path. Leave blank to auto-detect yaps or yaps_cli in common install locations and Raycast's PATH.

commands.name: search-memory
commands.title: Search Yaps Memory
commands.subtitle: Local Vault
commands.description: Search your private Yaps vault and inspect or copy matching notes.

commands.name: save-clipboard
commands.title: Save Clipboard to Yaps
commands.subtitle: Quick Capture
commands.description: Save clipboard text as a Markdown note in your Yaps vault.

preferences.name: captureFolder
preferences.title: Clipboard Capture Folder
preferences.description: Vault-relative folder used by Save Clipboard to Yaps, such as Inbox.

commands.name: open-yaps
commands.title: Open Yaps
commands.subtitle: Desktop App
commands.description: Launch Yaps, or open its download page if it is not installed.

scripts.fix-lint: eslint src --fix && prettier --write src tests package.json tsconfig.json README.md eslint.config.js
scripts.lint: eslint src --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json README.md eslint.config.js && tsc --noEmit
